t: This Fortress Trade 9" Roller Tray & Inserts Pack provides a robust and practical solution for painting and decorating. Constructed from durable plastic, the grey tray features raised ridges to facilitate even paint loading onto rollers and efficient removal of excess paint. Its deep well is designed to hold ample paint, reducing interruptions during tasks such as painting walls and ceilings in homes or commercial properties. This pack includes three convenient tray inserts, extending the life of the main tray and allowing for quick colour changes on busy sites. The entire unit is straightforward to clean after use, making it an essential piece of equipment for decorators and construction workers.
